# Goody — account brief

## Who

Goody is a gifting platform for sending personal and business gifts without needing an address ([source](https://ongoody.com/)). Its GitHub org is Goody, at ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).

## Production Expo signals

- eas.json is committed in ongoody/goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json pins react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under .github/workflows ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 11 public repos and 64 followers ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).
- goody-app was last pushed 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)).
- The App Store listing has 5,400 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)).
- 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)).
- Goody links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://ongoody.com/careers)). The evidence does not say whether any role there is mobile or React Native.

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@ongoody-maintainer-1), top contributor to ongoody/goody-app with 96 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)). The profile lists company "Goody" and website https://ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)). No title or team is listed.
- Maintainer Two (@ongoody-maintainer-2), 40 commits to ongoody/goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)). The profile lists company "Goody" and website https://ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)). No title or team is listed.
- @ongoody-maintainer-3, 12 commits to ongoody/goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-3)). The record lists nothing else about them.

## Why now

goody-app was last pushed 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)) and the store listing shows 4 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). The app is on react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One — you have 96 commits in goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)), and the repo carries both an eas.json ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json)) and its own GitHub Actions workflows ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)). Four store releases went out in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). Where does the split fall between those workflows and EAS today, and when a fix has to reach users between those releases, does it go over the air or wait for review?
